turns.question: What was the average number of days between the order date and the return date for returns dated between 1 and 4 October 2026?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no metric for the average number of days between order and return, so I cannot give that figure; the closest is Returns (returns_count), which had 3 returns recorded from 1 to 4 October 2026, counted on the return date (Returns by order date counts them on the order date instead). Fresh: returns.silver is ready up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z.
